reviews.title: Great. But a waste of storage
reviews.text:
Abhorrent waste of time. 

I used this app for 4 years for secret Santa at work, school, with friends and family. But this year I’m so let down. 

None of us use it anymore. Because whenever we use it, it kicks us off the app. Also, it says it doesn’t recognise our celebration!!! 

There are over two dozen of us and we all got kicked off!?!!?

reviews.title: Not convenient
reviews.text: This app doesn’t alert participants of the exchange or their assigned person. Every person in the exchange has to download the app and login. It’s very inconvenient when you’re including kids or older folks in your exchange. We used it last year, and it was a nightmare. Looking for a better app this year that doesn’t require every single person to download and login to the app.

reviews.title: App has changed 2025
reviews.text: You can no longer just type to add things to your “wish list”, you can only add specific items from the search engine within the app. Before you could just list  “knitted blanket” and leave it up the imagination of whoever drew your name. reviews.title: Too Much *Required
reviews.text: I just want an app to draw names for secret Santa. That's it! I shouldn't have to jump through a million loopholes to get there. I put in all the names and even put in the names that certain people could not draw and I get to the end and it will not draw names unless you send out invitations and then even when you send out invitations it will not let you draw the names until people respond. Deleting app.

reviews.title: Website it okay but app is not usable
reviews.text: I’d been added to one secret Santa for work. I was using it to make the list on Safari. Then I thought I might want to use it with more people and got the app. The app doesn’t let me sign in. All the details were correct. I was signed out of safari. Just says there is an error. I’ll be using safari for work then and once we finish I won’t use it again cos even safari is janky but it’s better than not working at all
